method.themes: case-insensitive regex, overlapping categories; question and answer separately
method.commonQuestions: all distinct-upload pairs with word unigram/bigram sublinear TF-IDF cosine >= 0.40; English stop words; no inference of independent sessions
method.answerComparison: independent answer-gist TF-IDF cosine for retrieval context only; agreement not assessed
method.keywordExtraction: 100 highest summed normalized word unigram/bigram TF-IDF features across candidate questions
method.uncertainty: lexical possibility/conditional/probability/absolute/imperative markers; no validated epistemic scale

sensitivity.retrievalThresholdScope: Recounts the retained >=0.40 lexical candidates; thresholds are exploratory retrieval choices, not validated question-equivalence cutoffs.

uploadPairConcentration.interpretation: Concentration of retrieval matches; neither an independent-session count nor a measured repost rate.

review.accessDepth: Existing AI-generated question and answer-gist fields; no raw transcript, audio or video inspected
review.selection: First pair from 20 evenly spaced positions in filename-sorted digests containing at least one qa_topics entry: round(i*66/19), i=0..19
observations: Question keywords alone miss answer mechanisms: a contact question can receive an excitement/formula answer.
Lexical similarity does not establish doctrinal agreement: shared subject matter can have different certainty, time windows, or attribution.
Interview and claimed-channeling contexts are mixed; assigning all answers to an entity would overstate speaker evidence.
Percentages and precise years in a digest are attributed assertions rather than measured probabilities or verified chronologies.
The physical-claims theme includes reported health assertions; these counts do not assess clinical validity.

pairReview.selection: First 12 distinct left-question strings in descending question-cosine order, tie-broken by candidate IDs; purposive high-similarity examples, not representative validation
pairReview.sourceDepth: Released AI-generated question/answer gists only; no transcript or audio/video verification
pairReview.scope: Within Darryl Anka/Bashar context across uploads; not cross-practitioner answer comparison
pairReview.agreementMeasure: No validated agreement score; the following readings are model interpretations

limitations: All candidate pairs are inherited AI-generated digest paraphrases, not transcript quotations or observed speaker turns.
All 949 current candidates share Darryl Anka/Bashar practitioner context. Cross-practitioner question or answer comparisons are unavailable.
Publishing accounts are distribution routes; comparing them is not comparing different mediums or attributed entities.
Bashar is a contextual entity label. Interview answers may be Darryl Anka's speech; no turn-level entity attribution has been verified.
Question wording, answer gist, inclusions and omissions were selected by the earlier digest generator. Counts describe digest entries, not every question asked.
Different uploads may repeat an original session. Near-question pairs are retrieval suggestions, not independent repetitions or agreement evidence.
TF-IDF question/answer cosine measures shared lexical features. It does not establish semantic equivalence, contradiction, influence, or answer agreement.
Regex themes overlap and are unvalidated descriptive indicators. Absent markers do not establish absent themes or certainty.
No timestamps, audio/video listening, caption-error audit or human labels were produced by this extraction.
The model-assisted close-reading subset inspects existing digest pairs only; it is not independent transcript or human construct validation.
